Hello,

Thank you for reaching out about your wedding. I can see why you'd like to move it, and I want to be clear about how our rescheduling policy works.

Under our policy, an event can be moved once, at no charge, to any available date within 12 months of the original date, as long as the change is requested more than 90 days before the event. Payments already made carry over to the new date. If the new date has a higher rental rate or food and beverage minimum, the difference applies.

Your event is on Saturday, May 16. That is 75 days from today, which is inside the 90-day window. Under our policy, a change requested at this point is handled as a cancellation, so I can't switch the date through this email. I've passed your request to a coordinator, who will review your existing booking and go over your options with you personally.

To help them, could you please reply with the following:
- The September date (or dates) you have in mind
- The number of guests you expect
- Whether you'd prefer the same room as your original booking

Once I have the September date, I can also check whether it's open for you. Please note that no date is reserved until a signed event contract and deposit are in place.

Warm regards,
The Larkspur Hall events team

texts:
Hello,

Thank you for your interest in hosting a wedding at Larkspur Hall. The total cost depends on the room, the date, and the number of guests, so there isn't a single flat price. Here is how it breaks down:

Room rental: Rates depend on the room, day of the week, and season. For example, the Grand Hall rental for a Monday through Thursday event in March (off-season) is $3,500.00 (the Grand Hall rental on Monday to Thursday, November through April; the rental only, before food, drink, fees and tax). Peak season is May through October, and Saturdays in peak season are our highest rate.

Catering is priced per guest:
- Classic package ($95 per guest): passed appetizers, a plated or buffet dinner with two entrées, house wine and beer for four hours, and coffee and tea.
- Signature package ($135 per guest): everything in Classic, plus a stationed appetizer display, a three-course plated dinner with a choice of three entrées, a premium bar for five hours, and a champagne toast. Signature couples also receive a complimentary tasting for two after signing their contract.

Other costs to plan for: each room and date has a food and beverage minimum, a 22% service fee applies to food and beverage, and 8.5% sales tax applies to the full bill. Optional add-ons include a late-night snack ($12 per guest), a ceremony on the Garden Terrace from May through October ($1,500), and an extra hour of event time ($750) for evening events in the Grand Hall or Library Room.

To give you a real estimate, please send us:
1. The date you have in mind (or a few options)
2. Your preferred room (Grand Hall, Garden Terrace, or Library Room)
3. Your expected guest count
4. Whether you're leaning toward the Classic or Signature package

Once we have those details, I can prepare an itemized estimate for you. A coordinator is also available to talk through options for your date.

Warm regards,
The Larkspur Hall events team
